title: Personal Statement Brainstorm
subtitle: brainstorm worksheet
note: Fill this in with notes, not sentences. The AMCAS essay is 5,300 characters with spaces (2027 AAMC applicant guide), so you're looking for 2-3 moments and one thread, not your whole resume.

lines: ~A moment with someone you were helping:
~A time you felt out of your depth and kept going:
~What you've seen doctors do that you want to do:
~Why this and not nursing, PA, research or teaching:
~Your answer in one sentence, to a friend:
~The one idea every paragraph comes back to:
~Opening: a real scene (not a quote or definition):

pins.headline: Brainstorm your personal statement
items: Find 2-3 moments, not your whole resume
Pair each trait with a real story
Pick one thread for every paragraph
Open with a real scene, not a quote
pins.title: Med School Personal Statement Brainstorm (Free Worksheet)
pins.description: Stuck on a blank page? Start with notes, not sentences! Find 2-3 moments that stuck with you, pair your traits with real stories, get specific about why medicine, and pick one thread. Free printable brainstorm worksheet from a current med student.

pins.quote: Why medicine, and not nursing, PA or research?
pins.headline: Get specific about why
pins.title: The Personal Statement Question Most Applicants Skip
pins.description: "I want to help people" fits a lot of careers. The strongest answers show what you've seen doctors do that you want to do yourself. Work it out on the free brainstorm worksheet before you write a single paragraph!

pins.headline: Notes first, sentences later
pins.sub: Moments, traits, why medicine and your thread on one page
pins.title: Personal Statement Brainstorm Worksheet for Med School
pins.description: One page to plan your AMCAS personal statement before drafting: the moments that stuck with you, two traits with proof, why medicine specifically, and the one idea that ties it together. Free printable!

pins.headline: 5,300 characters, one page
pins.sub: Spaces count, schools get plain text, and every school sees the same essay
pins.title: AMCAS Personal Statement Length and Format (2027 Guide)
pins.description: Per the AAMC's 2027 AMCAS applicant guide, the personal comments essay is 5,300 characters including spaces, about one page, sent as plain text to every school you apply to. No edits after you submit, so proofread! Free brainstorm worksheet in the post.
